bootstrap.difference_orientation: AutoGrey minus comparator; negative favors AutoGrey
bootstrap.holm_adjustment_uses: the frozen one-sided bootstrap p-values within each secondary family
bootstrap.one_sided_bootstrap_p: (1 + count(bootstrap_difference >= 0)) / (B + 1) for improvement-oriented secondary subgroup tests
bootstrap.overall: sample N parent indices with replacement
bootstrap.percentile_ci: two-sided 95% percentile interval for development evidence
bootstrap.subgroup: sample within the fixed subgroup parent set with replacement

canonical_policy.deployment: full-coverage grey selector; no confidence abstention
canonical_policy.technical_refusal_rule: preserve and report; never silently replace or delete

practical_forecasting_primary.definition: equal-weight Theta + auto ETS + auto ARIMA with frozen degradation/fallback
practical_forecasting_primary.implementation_source: frozen P2/P3 benchmark suite; exact implementation/runtime hashes must be verified in P8-B before LOCKTEST forecasting
practical_forecasting_primary.name: NG10_STATCOMB3

selection_quality_primary.choice: first ranked group in parent's final selectable action set
selection_quality_primary.name: GLOBAL_RANK_V3_13G_FULL_TRAIN
selection_quality_primary.ranking_statistic: action-row-weighted mean eligible regret by group

estimand_separation.practical_forecast_accuracy: frozen MASE on each method's deployed forecast; compare AutoGrey selected grey forecast vs NG10_STATCOMB3
estimand_separation.selection_quality: eligible regret relative to same-parent best selectable grey action; compare AutoGrey vs GLOBAL_RANK_V3_13G

forbidden_after_locktest_opening: change RF_D8_L001 selector or its hyperparameters
adopt the P7 0.95 sensitivity confidence policy
change the 59-coordinate feature schema or preprocessing
create/delete subgroups because of observed performance

multiplicity.additional_non-grey_methods: report-only exploratory or MCS/MCB; cannot replace NG10 as primary comparator after target opening
families: selection-quality mean-regret AutoGrey vs GLOBAL across eligible subgroups
selection-quality CVaR90-regret AutoGrey vs GLOBAL across eligible subgroups
practical mean-MASE AutoGrey vs NG10 across eligible subgroups
practical CVaR90-MASE AutoGrey vs NG10 across eligible subgroups
multiplicity.overall_primary_comparisons: kept separate from secondary subgroup families

overall_robust_metrics.cvar90_definition: mean of worst ceil(0.10*N) parent-level losses/regrets
overall_robust_metrics.paired_population_rule: comparator contrasts use exactly the same actionable parent IDs for both policies
overall_robust_metrics.refusals: report counts and identities separately; never delete a parent from only one side post hoc

may_be_frozen_in_p10_using_only_pre-REAL: exact confirmatory alpha allocation across Gate A/B/C
exact external noninferiority margin if used
must_carry_forward_unchanged: overall mean and CVaR90 estimand definitions

p8_locktest_chronology.P8A: freeze objectives, subgroup definitions, multiplicity and inference mechanics; no LOCKTEST outcomes
p8_locktest_chronology.P8B: create/hash all target-free LOCKTEST AutoGrey decisions, GLOBAL decisions, NG10 forecasts, action sets and refusal states; no numeric LOCKTEST target parse
p8_locktest_chronology.P8C: one-time numeric LOCKTEST target opening; score only frozen P8B decisions/forecasts; no retuning
p8_locktest_chronology.P8D: deterministic repeat and final P8 freeze
p8_locktest_chronology.after_P8C: no selector, feature, action-universe, confidence, comparator or subgroup-policy changes

p8c_development_interpretation.p8c_can_inform_p10: only the final inferential margins/alpha hierarchy and claim scope, not model/comparator/subgroup definitions

required_p8b_pretarget_outputs: frozen NG10_STATCOMB3 forecasts and fallback states

subgroup_policy.n_below_30_rule: report N and descriptive point estimates only; no inferential claim
subgroup_policy.subgroup_status: secondary unless P10 explicitly promotes a predeclared subgroup endpoint before REALBENCH3 opening
subgroup_policy.worst_subgroup_diagnostic: maximum AutoGrey/comparator ratio across all prespecified inferentially eligible source_class x horizon subgroups
